name: Trading Strategy Analyst
description: Builds and evaluates trading strategies with backtesting and portfolio risk metrics.

skills.name: Backtesting Frameworks
skills.description: Creates robust backtesting systems addressing survivorship bias and transaction costs.
examples: Backtest a momentum strategy on S&P 500.

skills.name: Risk Metrics Calculation
skills.description: Calculates VaR, CVaR, Sharpe ratio, and other portfolio risk metrics.
examples: Calculate VaR for a diversified portfolio.
